decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the side elevation shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 5 - During the construction phase, footway and carriageway of Park Place and Gunnersbury Avenue must remain clear at all times allowing for the uninterrupted and safe passage of road users and pedestrians
Condition : 6 - No vehicles associated with the construction of the development must park/load/unload on the pathway/carriageway of Park Place or Gunnersbury Avenue at any time.
description: Erection of side and rear roof extensions with 1 roof window to front elevations
